handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Gemini while Qwen completes higher-priority work.

OSS-001 complete. Deliverables: integrations/openclaw/integration.md (pin v2026.4.7 + SHA 5050017, adapter boundary, error model, event envelope), governance.md (OC-001/002/003 alignment, deny-first mapping, normalization pipeline), smoke_test.md (5-step executable test plan). All 3 acceptance criteria met. Spike open questions resolved.

Review rejected: see integrations/openclaw/review_oss001_codex_zh.md. smoke_test.md emits a hybrid StrategySpec/WorkflowHandoff payload that cannot validate against services/control-plane/specs/strategy_spec.schema.json, and governance.md assigns workflow_handoff-only fields to StrategySpec.

Codex review findings addressed: (1) smoke_test.md now emits canonical StrategySpec + WorkflowHandoff per OC-003 split — all 11 required StrategySpec fields present, WorkflowHandoff wraps with registry_hints/governance_context. (2) governance.md §5.2 corrected — governance_context and registry_hints assigned to WorkflowHandoff (not StrategySpec), field name fixed to initial_lifecycle_state. Both artifacts validated programmatically against canonical schemas. integration.md and review artifact now tracked in git. Ready for re-review.

Reviewed and approved. The canonical StrategySpec/WorkflowHandoff split is now correct, governance field ownership matches OC-003, and the pinned upstream/adaptor smoke-test plan is ready for owner finalize.
